testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel closing a part while editing its sketch: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-tabs-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:103:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel closing a part while editing its sketch ✔ Given the user creates a new unsaved metric part and starts a sketch on its XY plane ✔ And the environment-exit message is enabled ✔ When the user clicks the close button on the part's document tab ✔ Then a dialog asks whether to exit the sketch environment and continue ✔ And the dialog offers OK and cancels ✔ When the user chooses Cancel ✔ Then the part remains open ✔ And the sketch editing environment remains active
